tokens.v: The steel vial stands upright in a fissure of sun-cracked earth at the very end of day, the low sun dragging its shadow a full metre across the clay plates while the kraft band glows amber along its lit edge. 50mm at f/4 at ground level shooting along the shadow's run, crack network converging toward a heat-hazed horizon, one dry grass stem leaning into the near-left corner out of focus, cut by the edge. FERNWEG reads hand-stamped small and clean into the kraft; the rollerball tip fires the frame's single brightest point.
